visual_elements:
An angry mob of over 1,000 whites gathers in front of Central High School, while nine African American students are escorted inside. The Little Rock police remove the nine children for their safety.

—Little Rock Central High School National Historic Site, National Park Service, www.nps.gov (accessed December 2, 2013)
